how_to_apply: Download the official notification PDF and print the prescribed application form provided at the end of the notice.
Fill in all required personal and educational details in the application form accurately.
Affix a self-attested passport-size photograph on the designated space on the application form.
Gather self-attested photocopies of all required mark sheets, certificates, and identity proofs.
Attend the walk-in venue on 14 October 2026 between 10:00 AM and 03:00 PM at the Office of the Chief Medical and Health Officer, District South Bastar, Dantewada (Chhattisgarh).
Submit the filled application form along with self-attested documents in person to the office authorities.
Carry all original documents for verification during the walk-in process.
important_instructions: Applicants must ensure they possess live registration in the Chhattisgarh Medical Council, which is mandatory. Experience certificates are considered valid only if issued by governmental and semi-governmental institutions (Central or Chhattisgarh government undertakings). Experience certificates must clearly state the duration of service; otherwise, the experience proof will be rendered invalid. Candidates must bring original copies of all submitted documents for mandatory verification during the walk-in. If any document or information provided by the candidate is found to be false during examination or after appointment, the candidature or appointment will be cancelled. Government or semi-government service employees must submit a No Objection Certificate (NOC) issued by the competent authority along with their application. Any candidate facing a criminal case/investigation in a police station or court, or whose case has been resolved or decided, must clearly mention the details in the application form. The applicant must remain personally present at the office venue on the scheduled date and time for submission and interview.
